row.team_price_text: Managed EDR: $7.99/endpoint/mo at 100 endpoints (MSRP $8.99), unlimited portal users
row.evidence: Huntress's SAML SSO guide says 'SAML SSO does not automatically create Huntress users. Add each user to Huntress before they sign in through SSO'; no SCIM is documented for the Huntress platform (portal) users.
row.notes: New row. Scored on the main Huntress platform (partner portal for Managed EDR, ITDR, SIEM, ISPM): no SCIM and no JIT; portal users are invited manually (unlimited users at no extra cost) or via the REST API memberships endpoints, and SAML SSO covers account-level logins only. Pricing is per endpoint, identity, learner or data source with no tiers or add-ons (Managed EDR $7.99/endpoint/month at 100 endpoints, MSRP $8.99), sold mostly through MSPs; per-user fields stay null. Separate product: Huntress Managed SAT (security awareness training, the former Curricula platform) has a SCIM 2.0 learner endpoint (https://mycurricula.com/api/learner-scim/v2) documented for Okta and Entra (non-gallery app) that pushes new learners and profile updates into a chosen SAT group; groups are not synced. That learner SCIM is not counted in status under the suite rule; reclassify at merge if SAT should be scored. The Okta OIN app is SAML only.

plans.name: Managed SAT
plans.notes: SAT has its own learner SCIM endpoint (learners, not portal users).

limitations.text: SAT learner SCIM (separate product): base URL https://mycurricula.com/api/learner-scim/v2, token from SAT Settings > Integrations > SCIM per target group; supports push new users and profile updates; user attributes userName (email), active, name.givenName, name.familyName, locale, preferredLanguage, timezone, plus enterprise department, employeeNumber, manager.value; group syncing must be disabled in Entra; one IdP app per SAT group.

scim.notes: scim.available is false for the Huntress platform; the SAML SSO guide says users must be added manually. Learner SCIM for Managed SAT is recorded under limitations and fallbacks.other_sync.

capabilities.notes: Users are managed as account or organization memberships; deleting a membership removes access but does not delete the user. Membership permissions include Admin, Security Engineer, User, Read-only, Finance, Marketing and Provisioner.

endpoints.purpose: Create a Membership (invite a user to the account or an organization)
Delete Membership (does not delete the user)
List memberships for a managed account (reseller)
Create a Membership in a managed account (reseller)

rate_limits.text: 60 requests per minute per API account, sliding window.

user_api.notes: No tiers or add-ons, so API access is not plan-gated (api_tax false).

okta.notes: OIN functionality list checks SAML only.

entra.notes: learn.microsoft.com huntress-tutorial returns 404; Huntress's Entra guides use a non-gallery app.

jumpcloud.notes: Huntress has a 'SAML SSO via Jump Cloud' help article (not loaded); no provisioning documented.

fallbacks.other_sync: Managed SAT only: SCIM 2.0 learner provisioning from Okta or Entra (https://mycurricula.com/api/learner-scim/v2)
